experiment_title: Per-model cost vs panel-% on Max 20x — controlled three-stage experiment
platform: Claude Code, subscription (Max 20x), session 5595198a... on macOS Darwin 24.6.0

stages.label: Pre-flight baseline
stages.notes: Clean conditions confirmed. 24 'concurrent' JSONLs were mtime-residuals from morning sessions, not active agents.

stages.label: Haiku audit pass — 7 parallel Explore subagents (background)
stages.notes: 7 Haiku Explore agents dispatched in background. None appear in toolUseResult.totalTokens in parent JSONL. They consumed real quota (panel ticked) but are invisible to per-spawn meter attribution.

stages.label: Sonnet implementation pass — 1 general-purpose subagent (background)
stages.notes: Sonnet subagent ran ~3.7min, 92K tokens self-reported. Did not appear in parent JSONL. After Change 2 (active_only filter) went live, the next report became the first non-contaminated report in the dataset (concurrent_active_5h_dollars = $0).

calibration_data_source: 41 reports in ~/.claude/skills/usage2/reports/ (mostly mtime-contaminated by historical residuals; account-scope panel-vs-dollar deltas are robust to that)

hypothesis_test.H1_null: Panel %s are linear in API-equivalent dollars regardless of model mix.
hypothesis_test.H2_alternative: Anthropic applies model-specific multipliers to session/week_all panels.
hypothesis_test.evidence: Stage 1 implied $1.71/pp; Stage 2 implied $1.78/pp; both within IQR of calibrate-account-scope's $1.63-$1.76. Cross-stage variance < 5%, well inside panel 1pp resolution noise floor. Cannot reject H1.
hypothesis_test.caveat: Each stage was dominated by main-thread Opus cost (cache-heavy). Background subagent contributions were invisible and likely small. A future experiment with explicit foreground Haiku/Sonnet/Opus dispatches and 5pp+ panel moves per stage could give a sharper test.

shipped_improvements: Fix calibrate KeyError (P0): tokens_per_percent -> dollars_per_percent + handle 'insufficient' sentinel
Add active_only=120s filter to find_active_jsonls; use for contamination flag (historical mtime residuals no longer trigger false contamination)
Security scrubs in cmd_contribute: drop timestamp_local, strip TZ from panel resets, replace concurrent_*_UUID lists with counts
Add calibrate-account-scope mode: extracts clean slopes from contaminated reports via Δaccount-$ vs Δpanel-%
Add estimate mode: '/usage2 estimate --model opus --tokens 1m' -> $/% of session
